WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as transaction_count
  FROM Accounts a
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    SUM(transaction_count) as sum_by_town
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY town_city
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.account_id,
    s1.town_city,
    s1.transaction_count,
    CAST(s1.transaction_count AS REAL) / s2.sum_by_town as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.town_city = s2.town_city
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(s3.transaction_count) as avg_transaction_count
  FROM step3 s3
)
SELECT 
  s3.account_id,
  s3.town_city,
  s3.transaction_count,
  s3.ratio,
  CAST(s3.transaction_count AS REAL) / s4.avg_transaction_count as final_ratio
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_transaction_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY final_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
